description: This file defines the EmployeeCSVImportAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for importing employee data from CSV files in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It handles CSV upload validation, processing via a service, and returns import results with success/failure metrics.

classes.name: EmployeeCSVImportAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for importing employee data from CSV files in OrangeHRM. Extends Endpoint and implements CollectionEndpoint, handling CSV upload, validation, processing, and result reporting.

methods.name: getPimCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the PimCsvDataImportService instance used for CSV import processing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles the import CSV POST request: retrieves attachment, validates, processes import via service, manages transactions, and returns success/failure metrics.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the request body containing the CSV attachment.

methods.name: getAttachmentRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for the attachment parameter, ensuring it's a valid Base64 CSV file.
